append.description: Add an item to the end of a list.
append.name: append

parameters.description: The list to add the item to.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The item to add. A list is added as a single item.
parameters.name: value

returns.description: The list with the item added at the end.

create_list.description: Create a list by entering its items one by one.
create_list.name: create_list

parameters.description: The items to put in the list, in order.
parameters.name: items

returns.description: The new list, with the items in the order entered.

filter.description: Keep only the items in a list that match a condition, and return them as a new list. Build the condition the same way as an “If” step, referring to the current item as “item”.
filter.name: filter

parameters.description: The list to filter. The condition reads each item in turn as item.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: Only items for which this is true are kept. Refer to the current item as “item” (for example, item.price is greater than 100).
parameters.name: condition

returns.description: The items that meet the condition, in their original order.

first.description: Get the first item of a list. If the list is empty, returns an empty list (shown as “Empty list”).
first.name: first

parameters.description: The list to take the first item from.
parameters.name: items

returns.description: The first item in the list, of whatever type it is, or an empty list if the list has no items.

group_by.description: Sort a list of records into groups that share the same value in one field, such as each owner's tasks. Each group has a key (the shared value), its items, and a count. Text matches ignoring case and spaces; records with a blank value are kept together in a group with a blank key.
group_by.name: group_by

parameters.description: The list of records (objects) to group.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The name of the field or column whose value decides the group, for example Owner email.
parameters.name: field

returns.description: One group for each distinct value of the field, in the order the values first appear.

count.description: How many records are in the group.

items.description: The group's records, in their original order.

key.description: The value this group's records share, or empty text for records with no value.

index_of.description: Find where an item appears in a list. Returns -1 if it is not found.
index_of.name: index_of

parameters.description: The list to search.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The item to look for. It must match an item exactly.
parameters.name: value

returns.description: The position of the first matching item, counting from 0, or -1 if the item is not in the list.

insert.description: Add an item at a specific position in a list.
insert.name: insert

parameters.description: The list to insert the item into.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: 0 is the first item.
parameters.name: index

parameters.description: The item to insert.
parameters.name: value

returns.description: The list with the item inserted at the position given.

last.description: Get the last item of a list. If the list is empty, returns an empty list (shown as “Empty list”).
last.name: last

parameters.description: The list to take the last item from.
parameters.name: items

returns.description: The last item in the list, of whatever type it is, or an empty list if the list has no items.

length.description: Count how many items are in a list.
length.name: length

parameters.description: The list to count the items of.
parameters.name: items

returns.description: The number of items in the list.

list_contains.description: Check whether a list includes a specific item.
list_contains.name: list_contains

parameters.description: The list to search.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The item to look for. It must match an item exactly.
parameters.name: value

returns.description: Whether the list includes the item.

merge.description: Merge two lists into one, keeping the items of the first list followed by the items of the second.
merge.name: merge

parameters.description: The list whose items come first.
parameters.name: first

parameters.description: The list whose items come after the first list's.
parameters.name: second

returns.description: One list: the first list's items followed by the second list's.

pluck.description: Turn a list of records (spreadsheet rows, orders) into a list of one field's values, such as every row's Amount, so you can total, average or join them.
pluck.display_name: Get one field from every item
pluck.name: pluck

parameters.description: The list of records (objects), such as spreadsheet rows or an earlier step's results.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The name of the field or column to take from every record, for example Amount.
parameters.name: field

returns.description: The field's value from each record, in the same order, with null where a record has no value for it.

remove_at.description: Remove the item at a specific position in a list.
remove_at.display_str_template: Remove the item at position {1} from {0}
remove_at.name: remove_at

parameters.description: The list to remove the item from.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: 0 is the first item.
parameters.name: index

returns.description: The list without the item at the position given.

remove_duplicates.description: Remove repeated items from a list.
remove_duplicates.name: remove_duplicates

parameters.description: The list to remove repeated items from.
parameters.name: items

returns.description: The list with repeated items removed, keeping the first of each.

reverse.description: Reverse the order of items in a list.
reverse.name: reverse

parameters.description: The list to reverse.
parameters.name: items

returns.description: The list's items in reverse order.

shuffle.description: Put the items of a list in a random order. Returns all of the items, just reordered.
shuffle.name: shuffle

parameters.description: The list to shuffle.
parameters.name: items

returns.description: The list's items in a random order.

slice.description: Take a section of a list, such as the first five items or the last three.
slice.name: slice

parameters.description: The list to take a section of.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: This item is included. Use a negative number to count from the end (-1 is the last item).
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: This item is not included. Leave blank to go through the end of the list. Use a negative number to count from the end (-1 is the last item).
parameters.name: end

returns.description: The items from the start position up to, but not including, the end position.

sort.description: Sort a list in ascending (first/smallest to last/largest) or descending (last/largest to first/smallest) order.
sort.name: sort

parameters.description: The list to sort. Numbers, and text that holds a number, sort by value.
parameters.name: items

parameters.description: The order to sort in.
parameters.name: direction

returns.description: The list's items sorted in ascending or descending order.

description: Count, sort, add, remove, and clean up lists.
